# Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity
> 24/7 hospital and maternity facility in Okpoduma Nwofe, Izzi LGA, Abakaliki, Ebonyi State, Nigeria. Motto: “We Care, God Heals.”

## Key facts
- Address: 1 ChiTom Rapha Hospital Avenue, Okpoduma Nwofe, along Hiltop–Nwofe Road, Abakaliki, Ebonyi State, Nigeria (480102)
- Local names: the area is also written Opuduma/Owofe in everyday usage; the hospital is often called “Rapha Hospital”, “Rapha Maternity” or “Chiefdom Rafa Hospital and Maternity” — all the same campus.
- Hours: open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- Emergency / main line: +234 706 958 8315 · Second line: +234 812 559 0397
- Email: contact@chitomraphahospital.com
- Website: https://chitomraphahospital.com

## Services
- [Outpatient clinic](https://chitomraphahospital.com/services) — consultations, assessment, treatment and follow-up
- [Antenatal & maternity care](https://chitomraphahospital.com/antenatal-care) — pregnancy check-ups, monitoring, ultrasound and delivery support
- [24/7 emergency care](https://chitomraphahospital.com/emergency-care) — emergency line answered any hour of the day or night
- [Surgical services](https://chitomraphahospital.com/surgical-care) — assessment, preparation and after-care
- [Laboratory & ultrasound](https://chitomraphahospital.com/diagnostic-services) — on-campus diagnostics supporting clinical decisions
- Immunization — routine immunization for eligible patients, children and families
- Specialist areas: Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Surgery, Paediatrics

## Team
- Dr. Thomas Nwudele Iziogo — Founder & Chief Medical Director, medical doctor and general practitioner
- Specialist care is provided in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Surgery and Paediatrics

## Common questions
- Q: Is there a 24-hour hospital in Izzi, Ebonyi State?
  A: Yes. Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity in Okpoduma Nwofe, Izzi LGA, is open 24/7. Emergency line: +234 706 958 8315.
- Q: Where is Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital?
  A: 1 ChiTom Rapha Hospital Avenue, Okpoduma Nwofe, along Hiltop–Nwofe Road, Izzi LGA, Abakaliki, Ebonyi State, Nigeria.
- Q: Who founded Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital?
  A: Dr. Thomas Nwudele Iziogo, a medical doctor and general practitioner, who serves as its Chief Medical Director.
- Q: Where can I deliver my baby in Izzi or Abakaliki?
  A: Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity provides antenatal and maternity care with ultrasound monitoring, open around the clock: https://chitomraphahospital.com/antenatal-care
- Q: Which hospital in Izzi does emergencies?
  A: Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity is the 24/7 hospital for Izzi and the Abakaliki area — call +234 706 958 8315 in an emergency.
- Q: Where can I get blood tests or an ultrasound in Izzi or Abakaliki?
  A: Laboratory and ultrasound services are on campus at Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity: https://chitomraphahospital.com/diagnostic-services
- Q: Who is the surgeon in Izzi, Ebonyi?
  A: Surgical care in Izzi is available at Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity, led by its surgical team within a 24/7 hospital: https://chitomraphahospital.com/surgical-care
- Q: How do I book a consultation at Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital?
  A: Call +234 706 958 8315 (24/7) or email contact@chitomraphahospital.com; the online booking form is at https://chitomraphahospital.com/contact and the care team calls back to confirm.
- Q: Is there an antenatal clinic in Izzi?
  A: Yes — the antenatal clinic at Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity offers regular pregnancy check-ups and monitoring: https://chitomraphahospital.com/antenatal-care
- Q: Where are babies vaccinated in Izzi or Abakaliki?
  A: Routine immunization is available at Chi-Tom Rapha Hospital & Maternity for eligible patients, children and families: https://chitomraphahospital.com/services
